rule: Within each predeclared variant choose C by 4-fold hostname-grouped training ROC-AUC subject to coefficient gates. Compare finalists on validation ROC-AUC; permutation and manipulation audit required before final freeze/test.

descriptions.body_query_precision: How much of the distinct body vocabulary belongs to the question?
descriptions.body_query_dice: How similar are the question and body word sets, accounting for both lengths?
descriptions.body_query_saturated_tf: How often do question words appear in body, with diminishing credit for repeats?
descriptions.body_query_bigram: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in body?
descriptions.title_query_precision: How much of the distinct title vocabulary belongs to the question?
descriptions.title_query_dice: How similar are the question and title word sets, accounting for both lengths?
descriptions.title_query_saturated_tf: How often do question words appear in title, with diminishing credit for repeats?
descriptions.title_query_bigram: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in title?
descriptions.description_query_precision: How much of the distinct description vocabulary belongs to the question?
descriptions.description_query_dice: How similar are the question and description word sets, accounting for both lengths?
descriptions.description_query_saturated_tf: How often do question words appear in description, with diminishing credit for repeats?
descriptions.description_query_bigram: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in description?
descriptions.path_query_precision: How much of the distinct path vocabulary belongs to the question?
descriptions.path_query_dice: How similar are the question and path word sets, accounting for both lengths?
descriptions.path_query_saturated_tf: How often do question words appear in path, with diminishing credit for repeats?
descriptions.path_query_bigram: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in path?
descriptions.headings_query_precision: How much of the distinct headings vocabulary belongs to the question?
descriptions.headings_query_dice: How similar are the question and headings word sets, accounting for both lengths?
descriptions.headings_query_saturated_tf: How often do question words appear in headings, with diminishing credit for repeats?
descriptions.headings_query_bigram: What fraction of adjacent question-word pairs appear together in headings?
descriptions.section_coverage_fraction_0_5: What fraction of sections cover at least 50% of question words?
descriptions.section_coverage_fraction_0_8: What fraction of sections cover at least 80% of question words?
descriptions.section_coverage_fraction_1_0: What fraction of sections cover at least 100% of question words?
descriptions.section_coverage_std: Is question coverage spread evenly across sections or concentrated in a few?
descriptions.top_three_section_coverage: How well do the three best sections cover the question?
descriptions.best_section_log_words: How long is the section that best matches the question?
descriptions.first_query_match_position: How far into the page is the first question word?
descriptions.query_match_density: What fraction of page words match the question?
descriptions.paragraph_log_median_words: How long is a typical paragraph?
descriptions.paragraph_log_p90_words: How long are the longer paragraphs?
descriptions.short_paragraph_fraction: How many paragraphs are short, readable chunks of 10 to 60 words?
descriptions.unique_word_fraction: How much vocabulary variety does the page have? This also depends on length.
descriptions.numeric_word_fraction: How often does the page include numbers?
descriptions.question_heading_fraction: How many headings are written as questions?
descriptions.log_link_count: How many links appear in retained blocks?
descriptions.links_per_1000_words: How link-heavy is the page relative to its length?
descriptions.heading_word_fraction: How much retained text is inside heading blocks?
descriptions.paragraph_word_fraction: How much retained text is inside paragraph blocks?
descriptions.list_item_word_fraction: How much retained text is inside list item blocks?
descriptions.table_word_fraction: How much retained text is inside table blocks?
descriptions.code_word_fraction: How much retained text is inside code blocks?
descriptions.answer_best_sentence_coverage: How much of the question appears together in one 6–80-word sentence?
descriptions.answer_top3_sentence_coverage: How much question coverage do the three best distinct sentences provide?
descriptions.answer_relevant_sentence_fraction: What fraction of distinct sentences cover at least half the meaningful question words?
descriptions.answer_log_relevant_sentences: How many distinct question-relevant sentences are available? Large counts are squeezed.
descriptions.answer_best_sentence_precision: How focused is the most question-dense sentence?
descriptions.answer_relevant_median_words: How long is a typical relevant sentence?
descriptions.answer_window_10_coverage: How much of the question occurs within a 10-word prose window?
descriptions.answer_window_25_coverage: How much of the question occurs within a 25-word prose window?
descriptions.answer_window_50_coverage: How much of the question occurs within a 50-word prose window?
descriptions.answer_relevant_union_coverage: Together, how much of the question do relevant distinct sentences cover?
descriptions.evidence_number_fraction: What fraction of relevant sentences contain a number cue? This does not verify truth.
descriptions.evidence_number_coverage: How well does the best relevant sentence with a number cue cover the question?
descriptions.evidence_unit_fraction: What fraction of relevant sentences contain a unit cue? This does not verify truth.
descriptions.evidence_unit_coverage: How well does the best relevant sentence with a unit cue cover the question?
descriptions.evidence_definition_fraction: What fraction of relevant sentences contain a definition cue? This does not verify truth.
descriptions.evidence_definition_coverage: How well does the best relevant sentence with a definition cue cover the question?
descriptions.evidence_linked_fraction: How often are relevant sentences inside a block with a link? A link need not be a trustworthy citation.
descriptions.evidence_numeric_intent_alignment: For a numeric question, does a relevant sentence contain a number?
descriptions.evidence_definition_intent_alignment: For a definition or explanation question, does relevant prose use an explanation cue?
descriptions.table_best_value_row_coverage: How well does one table data row cover the question, excluding header cells?
descriptions.table_top3_value_row_coverage: How well do the three best distinct table data rows match?
descriptions.table_relevant_row_fraction: What fraction of distinct table data rows cover half the question?
descriptions.table_numeric_row_coverage: How well does a table data row containing numbers match the question?
descriptions.table_header_best_coverage: What is the best question match within the headers of one table?
descriptions.table_numeric_intent_alignment: For numeric questions, how relevant is the best numeric table row?
descriptions.steps_best_coverage: How well does one distinct numbered step match the question?
descriptions.steps_relevant_fraction: What fraction of distinct numbered steps cover half the question?
descriptions.steps_howto_alignment: For how-to questions, is there a matching numbered step?

manifest.population: Exactly v4/v2 eligible records and hostname assignments; no reparsing or corpus-fitted feature transforms.
